author: Marlon Chaviano
name: api-nestjs
title: API with NestJS
description: An API with NestJS: modules, controllers and dependency injection, validation, tests with Jest and an architecture that holds up for large teams.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Organize by domain modules (`src/<domain>/`), each with its module, controller and service. Generate pieces with `npx nest g resource <name>`.
- Logic lives in services; controllers only translate HTTP. Inject dependencies through the constructor.
- Validate input with DTOs and `ValidationPipe`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build && npm test`.
